depicted_variant: Manifestasi siluman melalui benda menjadi sosok kecil berkulit gelap kasar, wajah tengkorak bertaring, rambut dan kuku panjang.

visual_requirements.description: Humanoid kecil10–20cm, kulit gelap kasar seperti mumi, wajah tengkorak bertaring, rambut panjang dan kuku panjang.
Mengambil bentuk melalui benda menjadi sesuatu yang menakutkan; tidak menampilkan kuasa perlindungan/balas dendam dengan efek yang tidak terdokumentasi.
Latar gelap abstrak editorial agar sosok kecil terbaca.

aura: Keganjilan manifestasi siluman c25 dan wajah tengkorak/taring/kuku c24 memberi ancaman pada skala kecil (klaim: jenglot-c25).
artistic_choices: Framing makro rendah menjaga tinggi10–20cm, butiran pasir besar memberi skala kecil.
Rambut panjang dan kain buram kecil menutup seluruh pelvis/dada; tanpa ketelanjangan atau darah.
Dipilih keyakinan manifestasi c25, tidak mengklaim semua benda jenglot hidup atau melakukan aksi fisik; rambut diterpa angin biasa memberi momen kemunculan.
Tidak memvisualkan balas dendam/proteksi sebagai efek karena mekanisme fisik tidak tersedia dalam klaim.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of JENGLOT, the frightening tiny humanlike form in the belief that a siluman manifests through an object.
ANATOMY: one miniature humanoid 10-20 centimetres tall, one skull-like face with protruding fangs, dark rough mummy-like skin, extremely long coarse black hair reaching its feet, two arms with long curled nails, two legs. Hair and a fully opaque small rough cloth wrap cover the chest and pelvis completely. No nudity. [jenglot-c24, jenglot-c06]
MOMENT: its frightening form becoming discernible from deep shadow, leaning visually over the macro camera, skeletal face suddenly revealed between wind-tossed strands, one long-nailed hand extended in the foreground. Depict a moment of manifestation, not a toy on a display stand. No claim of walking or consuming blood.
POWER: taking frightening physical form through an object is the selected belief; no visible magical energy, no revenge beams, no blood. [jenglot-c25]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low-angle MACRO ground view; the 10-20cm creature fills the square, large individual grains of sand and a dry leaf establish its tiny true size; never a human-sized giant.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one small amber oil flame off-screen lights the harsh fangs and rough skin from below, deep walnut black shadows, ordinary dust and a gust moving long hair.
SURFACE: dry cracked dark skin, coarse stiff hair, long keratin nails, gritty earth.
SETTING: minimal dark earthy backdrop, editorial staging of the object-manifestation belief. [jenglot-c25]
MOOD: dangerous and imposing, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: square at least 1024px; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: PNG asli dilihat: humanoid mini berkulit gelap kasar, wajah tengkorak bertaring, rambut panjang/kuku panjang c24/c06, satu kepala dua mata dua lengan dua kaki. Butir tanah dan daun memberi skala kecil. Momen bentuk menakutkan tersingkap c25 dengan rambut bergerak dan tangan foreshortened; semua tujuh Uji Sangar ya. Ini pilihan manifestasi c25, bukan klaim semua boneka jenglot bergerak; tanpa efek proteksi/balas dendam, darah, teks atau desain adaptasi. Kontak thumbnail asli berukuran200 piksel dilihat ulang bersama13 PNG lane-A; ciri subjek dan kesan sangar/agung tetap terbaca.

root_visual_review.notes: Tiny mummified fanged figure with long hair and long nails reaching out at macro scale beside a candle.
